description: Blind constant-modulus equalizer, normalized, fractionally spaced (conventions: Synchronization, Constant-modulus equalizer).

cases.source: by hand: with step 0 the taps stay a unit impulse at the center, so output n is x[2n] and the error is x[2n] (1 - |x[2n]|^2)
by hand: one tap on x = g a with |a| = 1 goes w -> w (1 + mu (1 - |w g|^2)) each symbol, from w = 1
by hand: unit-magnitude input at R = 1 gives error 0, so the tap stays 1 and the output is the input
by hand: zero samples give output 0 and error 0; the regressor power is 0, so the taps never move
